status: GENERIC PLACEHOLDER — the instrument, its items and its scoring must be chosen and approved by the Clinical Advisor before release (FR-INS-017). Nothing here is a validated measure.
_comment: FR-INS-018/019: the score is stored but never shown to the user, and the trend is drawn without numbers, severity bands or the name of any condition.
title: A few questions about the last two weeks
intro: Five quick questions. There are no right answers, and you will not be given a score — this only helps you see how things move over time.

items.text: Over the last two weeks, how often have you felt low or down?
How often have things you usually enjoy felt flat?
How often have you felt on edge or unable to settle?
How often has sleep been difficult?
How often has it been hard to get through the day?
